europe_now.title: Russian Drone Strike Hits Passenger Train Near Polish Border
europe_now.summary: A passenger train traveling from Kyiv to Warsaw was struck by a drone close to the Polish border amidst ongoing regional attacks. Authorities and transport services responded to the incident as cross-border security concerns escalated.

sources.headline: Drone hits Kyiv-Warsaw train close to Polish border during Russian attacks on Ukraine
Russian drone hits passenger train headed from Kyiv to Warsaw

europe_now.title: Mass Demonstrations Sweep Germany Following Far-Right Electoral Success
europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of people took to the streets across Germany to protest against the far-right Alternative for Germany party following its recent electoral gains. The large-scale rallies reflect deep societal and political divisions across the country.

sources.headline: Germany: Thousands rally against far-right after AfD victory
Tens of thousands protest against far-right AfD party in Germany

top_stories.title: Swedish General Election
top_stories.summary: Voters across Sweden participated in a closely contested general election that could bring the far right into government. Observers and political analysts closely monitored the polls as the nation faced a potential turning point in its political landscape.

sources.headline: Sweden election: A turning point for the far right?

top_stories.title: UK Political Funding Investigation
top_stories.summary: British police have launched a formal investigation into a substantial donation made to Reform UK. The inquiry focuses on a multi-million-pound contribution that has drawn intense scrutiny from regulatory and law enforcement bodies.
